nonzero_model_commands.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat README.md && cat pyproject.toml && rg --files src examples tests && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "cat src/compiler/__init__.py src/compiler/compile_action_policy.py docs/release-0.5.0.md && rg -n 'tmp|subprocess|write|cache' tests && ls /AGENTS.md /source/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; rg --files --hidden /source -g AGENTS.md"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "python -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/source')
out = Path('/scratch/output')
assert (root/'README.md').read_bytes() == Path('/scratch/README.proposed.md').read_bytes()
assert (root/'examples/compile_repository_policy.py').read_bytes() == Path('/scratch/compile_repository_policy.py').read_bytes()
code = (root/'README.md').read_text().split('"'```python'"\\n', 1)[1].split('"'```'"', 1)[0]
(out/'readme_public_example.py').write_text(code)
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/source/src', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', TMPDIR='/scratch')
origin_code = 'import compiler, inspect, json; from importlib.metadata import version; print(json.dumps({\"module\": compiler.__file__, \"api\": inspect.getfile(compiler.compile_action_policy), \"version\": compiler.__version__, \"distribution_version\": version(\"cricore-contract-compiler\")}, sort_keys=True))'
origins = {}
outputs = []
for mode, flags in [('workspace', ['-B']), ('public', ['-I', '-B'])]:
    origin = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *flags, '-c', origin_code], env=env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    origins[mode] = json.loads(origin.stdout)
    for name, script in [('example', root/'examples/compile_repository_policy.py'), ('readme', out/'readme_public_example.py')]:
        for repeat in range(2):
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *flags, str(script)], env=env, check=True, capture_output=True)
            assert not result.stderr, result.stderr
            contract = json.loads(result.stdout)
            assert set(contract) == {'schema_version', 'contract_id', 'contract_version', 'action_requirements', 'contract_hash'}
            digest = contract.pop('contract_hash')
            expected = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(contract, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()
            assert digest == expected, (digest, expected)
            outputs.append(result.stdout)
            (out/f'{mode}-{name}-{repeat+1}.json').write_bytes(result.stdout)
assert len(set(outputs)) == 1
(out/'import-origins.json').write_text(json.dumps(origins, indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\\n')
print(json.dumps(origins, indent=2))
print('Eight runs succeeded; all JSON bytes match; contract hash verified:', digest)
PY"
